summary: Frontend-only final mandatory retest completed on public preview. Unified spatial menu pointer routing is still non-deterministic and fails required matrix. Keyboard activation and Home-logo return pass. No console error selectors and no horizontal overflow detected.

ui_bugs.issue: Fresh pointer clicks for Legacy/Timeline/Cars/Tracks/Victories all landed on active-node-0 (ORIGIN) instead of target nodes.
Sequential session remained inconsistent: Legacy failed (stayed node 0), Cars failed (stayed node 2), Victories failed (stayed node 7), while Timeline and Tracks passed.
Quick menu open then Timeline click still lands at ORIGIN (active-node-0).
Timeline wheel-lock and arrow checks were blocked in mandatory path because timeline route did not land from menu click (active-node remained 0).

integration_issues.issue: Diagnostic trace shows __spatialGo is available, but some menu clicks never invoke it (legacy/cars/victories), while timeline/tracks invoke it and route correctly.
Successful links generated duplicate router invocations (3 calls per click), indicating competing onMouseDown/onTouchStart/onClick lifecycle and unstable deterministic behavior.

action_items: Fix deterministic pointer routing so all five required menu links always invoke spatial navigation and land correct active node.
Consolidate multi-event handlers (onMouseDown/onTouchStart/onClick) into a single deterministic interaction path to avoid duplicate/missed routing.
After fix, re-run mandatory matrix: fresh per-link, sequential matrix, quick open-click, keyboard Enter/Space, and timeline-through-menu lock/arrows.
Confirm gallery/quote/victory-filter checks after menu routing fix because failures became route-blocked in this run.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav links currently bind three event handlers to the same go() call; this produces triple invocations on successful clicks and zero invocations on some failed clicks, matching observed nondeterminism.
Spatial router readiness is not the current blocker: __spatialGo was true before clicks in diagnostic runs, yet specific buttons still did not invoke it.
Menu close (setOpen(false)) in same gesture path likely competes with multi-event lifecycle and can terminate/skip intended routing for certain button interactions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproduced blocking failure on public preview: fresh matrix failed all five links to ORIGIN, sequential matrix passed only Timeline+Tracks, quick Timeline click failed, keyboard Enter/Space passed, Home-logo return passed, no error selectors, no horizontal overflow. Diagnostic trace wrapped window.__spatialGo and confirmed calls absent for legacy/cars/victories but present (triplicated) for timeline/tracks.
rca of the issue: RCA/Repro: 1) Open menu and click Legacy/Cars/Victories -> active node does not move. 2) Same session click Timeline/Tracks -> route may work and __spatialGo gets called multiple times. 3) Hook trace shows __spatialGo exists before interaction, so failure is not readiness; it is click lifecycle inconsistency. Likely root cause is concurrent event bindings (onMouseDown/onTouchStart/onClick) with immediate menu close causing race/ordering variance where some clicks skip router invocation and others invoke it multiple times. Mitigation: use one canonical pointer/click event, debounce/guard duplicate invocations, then close menu after confirmed route dispatch.
